RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Focusing on the panel's gender without concrete evidence of bias is professionally risky and legally unsubstantiated. An all-female panel alone is not proof of discrimination. Modern newsrooms heavily prioritize digital media expertise, offering a clear, legitimate rationale for appointing the other candidate despite your longer tenure. 

Instead of alleging bias, follow up politely on your pending request for written feedback. Ask for constructive guidance on how to strengthen your digital skillset and interview presentation for future leadership opportunities. If verifiable evidence of improper procedure or unfair treatment surfaces later, you can reconsider your options then.
